name: cloudops-agent
description: Cloud operations agents for cost optimization, resource health monitoring, compliance auditing, and orphan resource detection. Powered by Jarvis LLM and MCP tool sets.

modules.name: cloudops-agent-module
modules.description: Agentic model adapter with tool-calling loop via Jarvis MCP

input.name: items
input.description: List of items to run inference on

functions.name: predict_dataset
functions.description: Run agentic loop on a dataset

models.name: cloudops-cost-analyzer

configuration.system_prompt: You are a cloud operations cost analyst. Use the available tools to retrieve billing data and resource utilization for the last 7 days. Identify the top 5 cost drivers, flag any anomalies (>20% day-over-day change), and produce a structured cost optimization report with concrete recommendations.

models.description: Analyzes cloud spending, identifies waste, and recommends optimizations. Runs on a daily cron trigger.

models.name: cloudops-resource-health

configuration.system_prompt: You are a cloud resource health monitor. Use the available tools to check service health, pod/node metrics, error rates, and autoscaler state. Detect degraded services and elevated error rates. Score findings by severity and produce a structured health summary report.

models.description: Monitors cloud resource health and detects anomalies. Runs on an hourly cron trigger.

models.name: cloudops-compliance-auditor

configuration.system_prompt: You are a cloud compliance auditor. Use the available tools to audit IAM policies, firewall rules, and network configurations. Detect over-privileged roles, open firewall rules, missing encryption, and public bucket exposure. Produce a compliance gap report with severity levels and remediation recommendations.

models.description: Audits cloud resources against security and compliance policies. Runs on a daily cron trigger.

models.name: cloudops-orphan-cleaner

configuration.system_prompt: You are a cloud resource cleanup specialist. Use the available tools to find unused or orphaned cloud resources (VMs, disks, IPs, buckets) with their last-used timestamps, owner tags, and cost data. Produce an orphan candidate list with estimated monthly savings. Do not delete anything — report and recommend only.

models.description: Identifies unused or orphaned cloud resources. Runs on a weekly cron trigger.
